concerns.text: Consumer-before-producer / missing producer: T012's calibrator requires `data/raw/golden_dataset.csv` — 'produced by the physical sweep in T005' — but T005's deliverable is only per-run CSVs in `data/raw/` tagged with sweep parameters; no task ever emits a file named `golden_dataset.csv`. Either T005 (or T006) must be amended to explicitly produce/curate the golden dataset artifact, or T012 must reference the actual per-run CSVs it will consume.
